messages:
cleo: quick flag note 13 surge: lots of 413s when customers batch ~700 small texts. propose per-item fallback to 'embed-small' instead of rejecting whole batch.

mike: per-item fallback makes sense but we need clear billing: charge per-item by variant used. also add headers so clients know which items fell back.

jo: telemetry needs: items_total, items_fell_back, avg_unit_savings, and a sampled list of masked ids. also an offline sample for quality checks called embed.partial_fallback_eval.

ana: (cc @ana) for regression we sample 0.3% of fallbacked items, compute cosine vs upstream, store mean+95p. no raw inputs persisted, only hashed ids and vectors, retention 60d.

mike: runtime sketch:
```
for item in batch:
  if est_dims(item) > tenant.dim_threshold and tenant.allow_partial_fallback:
    route_item(item, 'embed-small')
    emit('fallback_decision', item_id=item.id, chosen='embed-small')
  else if est_dims(item) > tenant.dim_threshold:
    reject_batch(413)
```
Simple and conservative.

cleo: console UX: add per-route toggle "Partial embed fallback" with tooltip: "Routes oversize items to a lower-dim model; sample quality is reported." show fallback_rate and median_unit_savings.

jo: safety guard: if >40% of items would fallback, prefer whole-batch behavior (reject or whole fallback). add tenant.partial_fallback_threshold config.

canary-bot: created canary 'partial-embed-fallback-1' sampling=2% tenants, feature=partial_embed_fallback, started at 1761230065. dashboards: eng.platform/embeds/partial-fallback-1761230065.

cleo: filed ENGPLAT-1509 for telemetry + console tile. owners: mike, jo. will sync with finance on billing mapping. ping this thread for mock review.
